summary: Frontend-only test of the contrast fixes across 5 themes, plus Brand Vault website import. Run on localhost:3000 with Playwright (local python, chromium headless_shell-1208). POSTs blocked everywhere except the e1test-owner import. (1) The /curriculum/about final CTA bug is FIXED in all 5 themes: cta-final-view and cta-view-curriculum are white on stone-900, and cta-final-pricing is dark text on white. (2) The contrast audit on 15 pages per theme at desktop 1920 dropped a lot. cellar went 206->26 (6 are emoji false positives), soft-cellar 734->35 (6 emoji), parchment 526->105, red-crush 504->94, white-crush 480->86. Mobile 390 shows the same pattern. Almost all remaining failures are in the 3 light themes and come from one cause: amber accent text oklch(0.5 0.14 62) in parchment and oklch(0.54 0.18 65) in the crush themes is used as small text on light surfaces (2.5-4.4:1). (3) Site footer, nav-professionals, .btn-amber, people filters, vault-role-badge and the pricing footer note are readable in every theme. Still failing: the MadeWithOwnology footer on /free-run in dark themes (1.57-1.81:1) and the work-mode pillar tags (3.02:1 in all themes). (4) Website import WORKS: 12 Patina wines found with correct vintages (2026 Rose, 2023 Chardonnay, Dark Horse and Old Tawny with no year). Unticking one gave 'Add 11 wines'. Save showed the toast '11 wines added to your vault', all 11 appeared in the list, and the protocol reads 'Imported from patinawines.com.au (https://patinawines.com.au/product/...)'. (5) FAILED: suggestedWebsite returns https://example.com for the e1test owner, not null. Because of this the dialog auto-opens on an empty vault and auto-runs an LLM read of example.com. The guided 'Import' button also auto-runs, since auto is set to !!siteUrl. That accounts for 1 of my 2 LLM calls (example.com, 0 wines); the other was Patina.

minor.issue: Returns {url:'https://example.com'} for e1test-owner@example.com. The FREE regex only excludes webmail domains, not reserved or test domains (example.com/.org/.net, *.test, *.invalid, localhost). Fix: add a RESERVED regex such as /@(example\.(com|org|net)|[^@]+\.(test|invalid|localhost))$/i.

No de-duplication. Importing the same site twice doubles every wine. It also inserts one row at a time without a transaction, so a mid-loop failure leaves a partial import. Consider skipping rows where (winery_id, name, vintage) already exists.
No per-owner rate limit on an LLM-backed mutation (about $0.002 per call). The llm-meter also logs 'unknown source brandPortal.websiteImport, defaulting to free tier'. Add a classifySource rule.

ui_bugs.issue: The guided 'Import' button (vault-import-website) calls setImporting({open:true, auto:!!siteUrl}). With a suggested URL it fires an LLM read immediately, before the user can check or edit the URL. Together with the example.com bug this reads the wrong site. Auto-open on page load does the same. Suggest pre-filling only and letting the user click 'Read my wines', or auto-running only when the URL comes from an outreach contact.

Text is 1.81:1 in cellar and 1.57:1 in soft-cellar ('Made with Ownology' at 2.32 and 1.75 in the audit). RCA: WorkModeLayout and FreeRun hard-code a light #F8F9FA surface, but MadeWithOwnology uses dark-theme tokens (--ow-amber 0.8 L, --ow-text-mid 0.72 L).

The inline colour #7a6440 at opacity 0.7 and 0.56rem italic gives 3.02:1 in all 5 themes (Learn/Know/Do/Guide under ASK/PRESS/LOG/TASKS/MORE). Needs at least 4.5:1: drop the opacity and darken, or use a token.

action_items: suggestedWebsite: exclude reserved/test domains (example.com etc.) so it returns null for the e1test owner.
Don't auto-run the LLM preview from the guided Import button or on page load; pre-fill the URL and let the user click 'Read my wines' (or auto-run only for outreach-contact domains).
MadeWithOwnology footer on the light work-mode surface in dark themes: use light-surface colours (e.g. a force-light wrapper) to reach at least 4.5:1.
Worknav pillar tags (#7a6440 at opacity .7): darken and drop the opacity to reach 4.5:1.

Light themes: add a darker amber text token (about oklch(0.45 0.13 60) or lower on parchment and crush) for small amber text, chips, citations, 'Reveal ->' and pricing badges; darken the KNOW/LEARN/GUIDE pillar text colours.
Fix the /home why-ownology-window text tokens, hero-carousel-skip, the cellar-brief status colours and the pricing 'The Vigneron' h3 in light themes.
Remove the mobile /dashboard light band above the footer and move the THEME pill clear of the bottom nav on work-mode pages.
Optional: dedupe importWines, add a rate limit on websitePreview, add a classifySource rule for brandPortal.websiteImport.
critical_code_review_comments: BrandPortal.tsx:131: onImport sets auto: !!siteUrl, so every guided Import click spends an LLM call on the suggested URL.
BrandPortal.tsx:84-89: auto-open on an empty vault fires an LLM call on first visit. If the URL is wrong (as with example.com) the user gets a 'couldn't find a wine list' state immediately.
brandPortal.ts:259 FREE regex: no reserved-domain exclusion. Also the outreach join takes the first matching row with LIMIT 1 and no ORDER BY, so the result is non-deterministic.
importWines: sequential inserts, no transaction, no dedupe.
ImportWebsiteDialog: 'Not now' keeps the stale preview.data, so reopening shows the old results; preview is reset only on a successful save.
WorkModeLayout hard-codes #F8F9FA and the pillar colours, so it ignores the theme tokens. This is the root of the /free-run and /dashboard dark-theme inconsistencies.

success_rate.frontend: Items 1, 3 (mostly) and 4 pass; item 5 fails; item 2 shows large drops but 86-105 real failures remain in each light theme

seed_data_creation: e1test users seeded; 11 Patina wines imported into the e1test-owner vault (winery 16062); everything removed with 'npx tsx scripts/e1-test-users.ts clean'. No real data touched. 2 LLM calls used (1 accidental example.com auto-run caused by the bug, 1 Patina).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use local python Playwright with executable_path=/pw-browsers/chromium_headless_shell-1208/chrome-linux/headless_shell (the default 1228 build is missing). Run `python3 tests/contrast_theme_audit.py audit <theme>` (desktop, all 15 pages), `... mobile <theme>`, or `... cta`. Set OWNER_JWT from `npx tsx scripts/e1-test-users.ts seed`. Running the 5 themes in parallel takes about 3 minutes. Under parallel load /admin/people sometimes shows people-error 'Unable to transform response from server'; it is transient and loads fine on its own. For the import test, set localStorage ow_import_offered_16062=1 to stop the auto-open, but note that the guided Import button still auto-runs on the suggested URL until that is fixed; use import-website-button instead.
